integrity: The proof uses the exact spherical decomposition of the Gaussian residual vector, the chi-moment recurrence, and a reconstructed bivariate absolute-Gaussian moment identity. The packaged checker independently replays the latter numerically and checks the closed formulas over a wide finite range.
scientific_limitations: The universal homogeneous covariance law assumes iid Gaussian sampling.
The exact MAD correlation formula is for mean absolute deviation about the sample mean.
An equivalent identity may exist in older normal-theory or robust-scale literature.
title: Exact Gaussian coupling of sample mean absolute deviation and sample variance
